denied.detail: Recording cannot start. Allow the microphone in Just Speak's app permissions.
denied.title: Microphone Is Turned Off

granted.detail: Just Speak can use the microphone.
granted.title: Microphone Allowed

notDetermined.detail: You have not been asked yet. Allow it now so the first recording does not stop for a prompt.
notDetermined.title: Microphone Not Allowed Yet

restricted.detail: A device policy such as Screen Time or a work profile blocks it. Whoever manages the device can lift the restriction.
restricted.title: Microphone Is Restricted

denied.detail: The on-device model cannot run. Turn speech recognition on for Just Speak in Settings, or choose a cloud model.
denied.title: Speech Recognition Is Turned Off

granted.detail: The on-device recogniser is allowed for this app.
granted.title: Speech Recognition Allowed

notDetermined.detail: You have not been asked yet. Allow it now so the first recording does not stop for a prompt.
notDetermined.title: Speech Recognition Not Allowed Yet

restricted.detail: A device policy such as Screen Time or a work profile blocks it. Whoever manages the device can lift the restriction.
restricted.title: Speech Recognition Is Restricted

needsDownload.detail: Your spoken language is supported, but its on-device model is not on the phone yet. Download it from the dictation screen, or choose another mode.
needsDownload.title: On-Device Model Not Downloaded

ready.detail: The recogniser your dictation mode uses supports your spoken language and is ready.
ready.title: Speech Recogniser Ready

unavailable.detail: This phone does not offer the recogniser your dictation mode needs, so recording cannot start. Choose another mode, such as a cloud model.
unavailable.title: Speech Recogniser Unavailable

unknown.detail: Could not ask the system about the on-device model. A recording will still try to use it.
unknown.title: On-Device Model Not Checked

unsupportedLanguage.detail: The on-device recogniser has no model for your spoken language. Choose another language or another dictation mode.
unsupportedLanguage.title: Language Not Supported On Device

missing.detail: The selected model uses {provider}, and no key is saved. Add one or choose another model.
missing.title: Transcription Needs a {provider} Key

present.detail: A {provider} key is saved. {provider} checks it when a recording connects.
present.title: Transcription Key Saved

rejected.detail: {provider} did not accept the saved key. Replace it with a current key from your account.
rejected.title: {provider} Rejected the Transcription Key

unreadable.detail: The saved {provider} key could not be read securely. This does not mean it is missing; if it keeps happening, save the key again.
unreadable.title: Transcription Key Could Not Be Read

missing.detail: Cleanup is on and its model uses {provider}. Add the key, or turn cleanup off.
missing.title: Cleanup Needs a {provider} Key

present.detail: A {provider} key is saved. {provider} checks it when a recording connects.
present.title: Cleanup Key Saved

rejected.detail: {provider} did not accept the saved key. Replace it with a current key from your account.
rejected.title: {provider} Rejected the Cleanup Key

unreadable.detail: The saved {provider} key could not be read securely. This does not mean it is missing; if it keeps happening, save the key again.
unreadable.title: Cleanup Key Could Not Be Read

needsFullAccess.detail: The keyboard is added, but without Full Access it cannot hand dictation to the app or read its transcript back.
needsFullAccess.title: Keyboard Needs Full Access

notAdded.detail: Turn on the Just Speak keyboard in the phone's keyboard settings to dictate in other apps.
notAdded.title: Keyboard Not Turned On

ready.detail: The Just Speak keyboard is turned on in the phone's keyboard settings.
ready.title: Keyboard Ready
